label: <DEL> step of c-initial sequences containing m at position 2-3 (L=6-7)
explanation: Extremely sparse: 26 activations in 1M sequences. Fires only at the delimiter step, never in the original or copy phases. 14/15 dev activations have first original token c (the 15th starts with 3), almost all contain m at position 2 or 3, and L is 6-7 (one at L=8). The last original token is usually u/w/g. The largest activation (2.38, about 5x the next) is on c 3 m k w u. The predicate catches ~97% of activation mass but has very low precision (~3%). Adding a last-token condition raises precision to ~25%, but that is overfit to 15 examples. Looks like a narrow lookup on the specific sequence prefix, probably a dead or nearly dead feature.
